headline: Dhaka summons Indian envoy after Advisor Zahed stopped at Delhi airport
summary: Bangladesh has issued a formal protest note to India after Information and Broadcasting Advisor Zahed Ur Rahman was stopped by immigration at Delhi airport.
details: Bangladesh has summoned the Indian Acting High Commissioner, Pawan Kumar Badhe, in Dhaka following an incident at Delhi airport.

caption:
Bangladesh summons Indian envoy after PM's advisor is stopped by immigration at Delhi airport.

Bangladesh has summoned the Indian Acting High Commissioner, Pawan Kumar Badhe, in Dhaka following an incident at Delhi airport.

The diplomatic action comes after Zahed Ur Rahman, the Information and Broadcasting Advisor to the Prime Minister, was stopped by immigration officials in Delhi.

Foreign Ministry officials confirmed that a formal protest note was handed to the Indian envoy on Monday.

Foreign Minister Khalilur Rahman described the incident as completely 'unexpected and unfortunate'.

The ministry is currently taking appropriate steps to address the situation and promised further details later in the day.

A formal media statement detailing the diplomatic summons is expected to be issued by the ministry later this evening.

headline: UAE likely to extradite Benazir Ahmed to Bangladesh within a month
summary: Former IGP and Rab chief faces around 10 ICT cases involving allegations of enforced disappearances, torture, and extrajudicial killings.
details: Former Inspector General of Police (IGP) and Rab chief Benazir Ahmed is facing approximately 10 cases at the International Crimes Tribunal (ICT), according to Chief Prosecutor Md Aminul Islam.
The Bangladesh government has initiated diplomatic efforts to seek his extradition from the United Arab Emirates, where he was arrested by Dubai Police on June 12.
The charges against him include the killing of Akramul Haque, a former councillor of Teknaf, and the 2013 Shapla Chattar crackdown, for which investigations are nearing completion.
Chief Prosecutor Aminul Islam stated that investigations are ongoing in six to seven other cases involving allegations of enforced disappearances, torture, and extrajudicial killings.

caption:
Former IGP Benazir Ahmed faces 10 ICT cases. He is expected to be extradited from the UAE within a month.

Former Inspector General of Police (IGP) and Rab chief Benazir Ahmed is facing approximately 10 cases at the International Crimes Tribunal (ICT), according to Chief Prosecutor Md Aminul Islam.

The Bangladesh government has initiated diplomatic efforts to seek his extradition from the United Arab Emirates, where he was arrested by Dubai Police on June 12.

The charges against him include the killing of Akramul Haque, a former councillor of Teknaf, and the 2013 Shapla Chattar crackdown, for which investigations are nearing completion.

Chief Prosecutor Aminul Islam stated that investigations are ongoing in six to seven other cases involving allegations of enforced disappearances, torture, and extrajudicial killings.

Additionally, the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has filed a separate case against the former police chief regarding financial crimes.

If returned to Bangladesh, Benazir Ahmed will be produced before the relevant courts and the government will seek remand for cases still under investigation.
